The `package()` function installs only the built binaries and metadata into standard system locations, with no extraneous system modifications. There are no obfuscated commands, network exfiltration attempts, or execution of external scripts. The package conflicts appropriately with binary variants to avoid co-installation issues.

While the JBR is downloaded from an external source, it is both pinned by version and verified with strong checksums, and its use is confined to the build phase. This is consistent with upstream's own build practices and does not represent a supply-chain risk.
</details>
